submission: Submit assets and manifest in a repository pull request for maintainer review. This template does not install or publish a pack.

avatar.format: Transparent RGBA PNG, up to 131072 bytes. Only artwork you have permission to share.
avatar.alignment: All twelve animation cells must contain artwork and transparent margins. Align the feet and character scale across frames.

review: Backgrounds use a 3:2 aspect ratio. Keep each asset under 2 MB; bake optional decoration into the background.
Positions are percentages from 0 to 100. Provide five collision-conscious station, aisle, and rest/gathering paths; preview the whole movement cycle.
Use local reviewed asset paths only. Installed packs contain no executable JavaScript, CSS, HTML, external URLs, or network requests.
Do not replace personal avatars. Include attribution, a license, and a thumbnail. Maintainers add approved manifests to the catalog and server theme allowlist.
